title: Intermediário
description: Conversas com opiniões, experiências e situações do trabalho e viagens.
goal: Você conduz conversas sobre temas do cotidiano, explica ideias e reage a opiniões diferentes.

units.title: Opiniões e experiências
units.goal: Compartilhar o que pensa e o que já viveu, com argumentos simples.

lessons.title: Conversa: um filme que você viu
lessons.objective: Dar opinião sobre algo que viu e justificar.
lessons.explanation:
Para opinar e justificar:

- *I thought it was really good, because the story was original.*
- *To be honest, I found it a bit slow.*
- *What I liked most was the ending.*

Depois de uma opinião, justifique com *because*.

key_phrases.en: To be honest, I found it a bit slow.
key_phrases.pt: Para ser sincero, achei um pouco lento.

key_phrases.en: What I liked most was the ending.
key_phrases.pt: O que mais gostei foi o final.

exercises.prompt: Have you seen the new film everyone is talking about?
exercises.context: Um colega quer saber sua opinião sobre um filme.
exercises.hint: Diga se viu e o que achou.
answers: Yes, I saw it last week. I really liked it.
Not yet, but I heard it's good.
I did. To be honest, I found it a bit long.
exercises.explanation: Responda com a experiência e uma opinião.

exercises.prompt: Really? Why did you like it?
exercises.context: O colega quer saber o motivo da sua opinião.
answers: Because the story was original and the acting was great.
I liked it because the music was amazing.
Because it made me think about my life.
exercises.explanation: *Because* + motivo.

exercises.prompt: Interesting! Did you disagree with anything?
exercises.context: O colega quer saber se há algo de que você não gostou.
exercises.hint: Diga o que não gostou, com educação.
answers: I think the ending was a bit predictable.
I didn't like the main character much.
I see your point, but I found the second half slow.
exercises.explanation: *I see your point, but...* é uma forma educada de discordar.

exercises.prompt: Ouça e digite a frase.
exercises.text: What I liked most was the ending.
answers: What I liked most was the ending.
exercises.explanation: Estrutura *What I liked most was...*.

lessons.title: Conversa: uma viagem marcante
lessons.objective: Contar uma experiência de viagem com detalhes.
lessons.explanation:
Para contar uma viagem, combine *present perfect* (experiência) e *past simple* (o que aconteceu):

- *I've been to Japan twice. The first time I visited Tokyo.*
- *We stayed in a small hotel, which was amazing.*

Use conectores: *first, then, after that, finally*.

key_phrases.pt: Eu já fui a Portugal duas vezes.

exercises.prompt: Have you ever travelled abroad?
exercises.context: Um novo amigo pergunta sobre suas viagens.
exercises.hint: Diga se já viajou e para onde.
answers: Yes, I've been to Portugal twice.
Yes, I went to Argentina last year.
Not yet, but I'd love to visit Japan.
exercises.explanation: *I've been to* para experiências; *I went to* para viagens com data.

exercises.prompt: Oh nice! What was the best part?
exercises.context: O amigo quer saber o melhor momento da viagem.
answers: The food was amazing and the people were friendly.
We visited a beautiful old church.
I loved walking along the beach at sunset.
exercises.explanation: Detalhes sensoriais deixam a história viva.

exercises.prompt: Sounds unforgettable! Would you go back?
exercises.context: O amigo pergunta se você voltaria.
exercises.hint: Diga se voltaria e por quê.
answers: Definitely! I'd like to go back next summer.
Maybe, if I had more time.
I'd go back, because there's so much more to see.
exercises.explanation: *I'd like to* + verbo para desejos.

exercises.prompt: Monte a frase: primeiro visitamos o museu e depois almoçamos
answers: First, we visited the museum then had lunch.
exercises.explanation: *First, ... then ...* organiza a sequência.

lessons.title: Conversa: concordando e discordando
lessons.objective: Reagir a opiniões diferentes sem perder a cordialidade.
lessons.explanation:
Para concordar: *I totally agree.* / *That's a good point.*

Para discordar com educação: *I see what you mean, but...* / *I'm not sure I agree.*

Para pedir mais informações antes de discordar: *Why do you think that?*

key_phrases.en: I see what you mean, but...
key_phrases.pt: Entendo o que você quer dizer, mas...

exercises.prompt: I think working from home is better than going to the office.
answers: I see what you mean, but I think offices help teamwork.
I partly agree. It saves time, but people miss the social side.
I totally agree with you!
exercises.explanation: *I partly agree* é uma concordância parcial muito usada.

exercises.prompt: Why do you think that?
exercises.context: O colega quer que você justifique sua posição.
answers: Because it gives people more flexibility.
I think it's easier to communicate in person.
Because we save time on the commute.
exercises.explanation: Justifique sua posição com um motivo claro.

exercises.prompt: That's a fair point. What would you suggest?
exercises.context: A discussão chegou a uma solução possível.
answers: Maybe we could try a mix of both.
What if we had two days at the office each week?
I'd suggest a trial period first.
exercises.explanation: *Maybe we could...* / *What if...?* para sugerir.

exercises.prompt: Qual frase discorda com educação?
options: I see your point, but I'm not sure I agree.
exercises.explanation: Reconhecer o ponto antes de discordar é o mais educado.

units.title: No trabalho
units.goal: Conversar com colegas, atualizar projetos e marcar reuniões.

lessons.title: Conversa: atualizando um projeto
lessons.objective: Dar e pedir atualizações sobre o andamento de um trabalho.
lessons.explanation:
Para atualizar: *We're on track.* (no prazo) / *We're a bit behind schedule.* (atrasados)

Para perguntar: *How's the project going?* / *Have you finished the report yet?*

Tempos verbais: *present perfect* para o que já foi feito, *will* para o que vai acontecer.

key_phrases.en: Have you finished the report yet?

exercises.prompt: How's the project going?
exercises.hint: Diga se está no prazo ou atrasado.
answers: We're on track. We should finish by Friday.
We're a bit behind schedule, but we're catching up.
It's going well. We've completed the first phase.
exercises.explanation: Atualize com status e próximo passo.

exercises.prompt: Have you sent the client the updated proposal?
exercises.context: O gerente pergunta sobre uma tarefa.
exercises.hint: Diga se já enviou ou quando vai enviar.
answers: Not yet. I'll send it this afternoon.
Yes, I sent it yesterday.
I've sent a draft, and I'll send the final version tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: *Not yet* + previsão com *will*.

exercises.prompt: Great. Is there anything blocking you?
exercises.context: O gerente quer saber sobre impedimentos.
exercises.hint: Peça ajuda se precisar, ou diga que está tudo bem.
answers: I need some feedback from the design team.
Nothing at the moment, thanks.
Could you help me get access to the data?
exercises.explanation: Pedir ajuda com clareza agiliza o trabalho.

exercises.prompt: Ouça e digite a frase.
exercises.text: We've made good progress this week.
answers: We've made good progress this week.
We have made good progress this week.
exercises.explanation: *make progress* = avançar.

lessons.title: Conversa: marcando uma reunião
lessons.explanation:
Para propor: *Would you be available for a call on Tuesday?*

Para confirmar: *That works for me.* / *Sounds good, see you then.*

Para remarcar: *Would it be possible to move it to Thursday?*

key_phrases.en: Would you be available for a call on Tuesday?
key_phrases.pt: Você estaria disponível para uma chamada na terça?

key_phrases.en: Would it be possible to move it to Thursday?

exercises.prompt: Hi! Are you free for a quick call this week?
exercises.context: Um colega quer marcar uma conversa rápida.
answers: Sure! How about Wednesday at 10?
Would Thursday afternoon work for you?
Yes, Tuesday at 3 would be good for me.
exercises.explanation: *How about...?* e *Would ... work?* são formas naturais de propor.

exercises.prompt: Unfortunately, I have a conflict on Wednesday. Could we move it?
exercises.hint: Aceite a mudança ou proponha outro horário.
answers: No problem. Would Thursday at 11 work?
Sure, let's do Friday instead.
That's fine, I'll send a new invitation.
exercises.explanation: Confirme a mudança e proponha alternativa.

exercises.prompt: Great, I'll send the invite now.
answers: Perfect, thanks! See you then.
That works for me. Thanks a lot!
Sounds good. Talk to you on Thursday.
exercises.explanation: Confirmações curtas encerram bem o combinado.

exercises.prompt: Qual frase remarca uma reunião de forma educada?
options: Would it be possible to move it to Thursday?
exercises.explanation: *Would it be possible to move it...?*

lessons.title: Conversa: num jantar de trabalho
lessons.objective: Conversar socialmente sobre assuntos profissionais e pessoais.
lessons.explanation:
Em jantares e cafés com colegas, perguntas abertas funcionam bem:

- *How long have you been working here?*
- *What's your favourite part of the job?*
- *Have you got any plans for the holidays?*

Também é comum elogiar com naturalidade: *That's a great idea!*

key_phrases.en: How long have you been working here?
key_phrases.pt: Há quanto tempo você trabalha aqui?

key_phrases.en: Have you got any plans for the holidays?
key_phrases.pt: Você tem algum plano para as férias?

exercises.prompt: How long have you been working here?
exercises.context: Um colega novo pergunta sobre seu tempo de empresa.
answers: I've been working here for three years.
Since 2021.
About two years now.
exercises.explanation: *for* + duração; *since* + ponto no tempo.

exercises.prompt: What's your favourite part of the job?
exercises.context: A conversa segue para o que você gosta no trabalho.
answers: I really enjoy working with the team.
I love solving problems for clients.
The best part is learning new things every day.
exercises.explanation: *I enjoy + -ing* para gostos.

exercises.prompt: Have you got any plans for the holidays?
exercises.context: A conversa muda para as férias.
exercises.hint: Fale de um plano usando *going to*.
answers: I'm going to visit my parents.
I'm thinking about going to the mountains.
I'm planning to rest and read a lot.
exercises.explanation: *I'm going to / I'm thinking about / I'm planning to*.

exercises.prompt: Monte a frase: essa é uma ótima ideia
answers: That's a great idea.
exercises.explanation: Elogio natural a uma sugestão.
